basic_info.description: This East facing open floor has been updated.  Living/dining room and kitchen bar. Handsome hardwood floors run throughout the unit. The open kitchen has all stainless appliances and granite slab countertop.  Bright spacious bedroom.   Perfect city residence in the North Waterfront neighborhood, a sunbelt location near the Bay. The building entrance has a roundabout driveway for drop offs and pickups, Parc Telegraph is a full-amenity building with 24-hour security/doorman, guest suite, modern fitness center, sauna and club room with full kitchen and bar area, and free laundry .  Parc Telegraph is located in a wonderful neighborhood nestled against historic Telegraph Hill. Underground secure parking across the street. Many conveniences within steps...grocery stores, deli, restaurants, Embarcadero. Perfect walking area. This property has it all.
